en-US.description: Fast and compact image viewer and converter
en-US.license: Proprietary, free for private and non-commercial use
en-US.longDescription:
IrfanView is a fast, compact and innovative FREEWARE (for non-commercial use) graphic viewer for Windows XP, Vista, 7, 8, 10 and 11.
It is designed to be simple for beginners and powerful for professionals.
IrfanView seeks to create unique, new and interesting features, unlike some other graphic viewers, whose whole "creativity" is based on feature cloning, stealing of ideas and whole dialogs from ACDSee and/or IrfanView! (for example: XnView has been stealing/cloning features and whole dialogs from IrfanView, for 10+ years).
IrfanView was the first Windows graphic viewer worldwide with Multiple (animated) GIF support. One of the first graphic viewers worldwide with Multipage TIF support. The first graphic viewer worldwide with Multiple ICO support.
en-US.name: IrfanView

zh-CN.description: 快速小巧的图像查看器和转换器
zh-CN.longDescription:
IrfanView 是一款适用于 Windows XP、Vista、7、8、10 和 11 的快速、小巧、创新的免费软件（非商业用途）图形查看器。
它设计简单，适合初学者使用，功能强大，适合专业人士使用。
IrfanView 致力于创造独特、新颖和有趣的功能，而不像某些图形查看器，其全部“创造力”都基于功能克隆、从 ACDSee 和/或 IrfanView 中窃取创意和整个对话框！例如 XnView 从 IrfanView 窃取/克隆功能和整个对话框已有 10 多年）。
IrfanView 是全球首款支持多重（动画）GIF 的 Windows 图形查看器，全球首款支持多页 TIF 的图形查看器，以及全球首款支持多重 ICO 的图形查看器。
zh-CN.name: IrfanView
